The '''''Turbulent''-class Star Destroyer''', also known as the '''''Turbulent''-class destroyer''', was a type of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] built by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] following the [[Swarm War]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Because of its smaller size, it was sometimes referred to as a "'''pocket Star Destroyer'''."<ref name="R" />

==Characteristics==
It was a smaller and more maneuverable variant of Star Destroyer and was designed with two [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] opening at the stern of the vessel. The ship's bridge was situated in a tower on top of the main superstructure. It had a large [[Hologram/Legends|holo-display]] built into its design and there was a day cabin available to the flag-officer near the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. An emergency [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] was located astern of the tower.<ref name="R" />

The class had many crisscrossing maintenance tunnels running throughout the upper portion of the vessel. This made maintenance easier and also provided a means of escape in case the ship was boarded. Because of the labyrinthine nature of this design, both boarding parties as well as escapees would have a difficult time navigating inside the vessel, unless informed of the specific escape routes that wound through the interior.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Another design focus was an extensive use of bulkheads throughout the interior.<ref name="R" />

==History==
The Remnant created the class after the end of the Swarm War, making it out to be a smaller and more agile design than previous Star Destroyers.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']] was one of these ships and saw action during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] liked the design, for it made it easier to familiarize with the crew than on a bigger warship.<ref name="R" />

It was the site of an attempted coup of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] by forces loyal to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].
Pellaeon was killed onboard the vessel, which was then boarded by [[Mandalorian Supercommando]]s and many crewmembers were killed. The vessel and Pellaeon's body were taken into custody by the [[Maw Irregular Fleet]].<ref name="R" />
